coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall of high-value local food-access misses. The primary nationwide production collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Only/sole/last/full-service grocery store loss, fire, or closure
Weather, fire, outage, or damage-driven emergency food distribution cancellation
Abrupt pantry or food bank shutdown or major access reduction
New official SNAP, WIC, EBT, or food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "sole grocery store" destroyed fire November 2026 community
coverage_notes.result: Twelve targeted current-web queries were run. No new in-window, independently verifiable event meeting these narrow classes was found. Returned hits were predominantly historical incidents, unrelated administrative or routine food information, and old SNAP disruptions.

Ruby's Pantry closure was reported April 1, 2026, outside hourly window.

coverage_notes.limitations: Search recency filters still return dated legacy articles. Unindexed local/provider announcements, real-time outages, and publication/indexing delays may be missed. No independently confirmed, newly posted official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption was recovered.
